title: D4 translation of the Lyons–Brown repeated-measurement/JIT model
purpose: Transfer the source's causal spacetime and commit/defer structure to the audited D4 projector/fusion interface before any stochastic performance sampling.

source_boundary.lyons_brown: Repeated stabilizer detectors, time-directed measurement faults, causal JIT commit/defer, absorber/ungauging lifecycle, and matched-history schedule semantics are transferred as structural rules.
source_boundary.d4_project: D4 m_flux/e_charge/vacuum projector states, none/blue/green herald reports, action-bound post-flux transition, and ground-state-relative nontrivial-winding logical scoring are project-defined replacements.
source_boundary.forbidden_claim: Do not call this an exact D(S3) circuit reproduction, and do not reuse Jing 2025 perfect-measurement thresholds as noisy D4 evidence.

state_and_observation_mapping.syndrome_record: Adjacent-round binary detector differences with known computational motion removed.
state_and_observation_mapping.measurement_faults: Independent syndrome-readout flips plus categorical herald false-negative, false-positive, and blue/green-confusion channels, with parameters exposed and normalized.
state_and_observation_mapping.action_transition: A committed D4 flux action binds to the E2 post-flux charge/vacuum transition before the next round.
state_and_observation_mapping.logical_score: Any nontrivial ground-state-relative winding action is a logical error, independent of the absolute topological-sector label.

schedule_contract.shared_history: All branches consume one immutable generated D4 history and digest.
schedule_contract.causality: Online branches see only the current causal prefix; offline is explicitly noncausal.
schedule_contract.jits: Retain detector age/geometry, absorber distance, deferral, ungauging, neutrality, correction, and re-gauging lifecycle from the translated schedule layer.

required: normalization of every D4 hidden-to-public report row
perfect-report and zero-noise limits recover the existing D4 deterministic interfaces
action digest binds the post-flux transition and cannot be replaced by an independent round resample
causal prefixes expose no future or truth-sidecar fields
all schedule branches use identical D4 histories and scorer semantics
no stochastic performance sampling before the interface matrix passes

next_gate: Implement and test the D4 translation interface matrix; only then register tiny matched-history stochastic pilots.
